title: Evidence contribution value
description: Value type for contributions on the Evidence panel. Evidence is ADDITIVE: every Evidence contribution stands on its own (the resolver for this panel is implicitly 'collect-all'). Consumed by ConfidenceSynthesisKSs.

source.description: Free-text identifier of the corroboration source (e.g. 'unit-test', 'integration-test', 'reachability-graph', 'documentation-presence').

weight.description: Signed contribution weight in [-1, 1]. Negative = counter-evidence.

supportingInterpretsIds.description: Ids of SourceInterpretation contributions this evidence cites.
